lines.text: Jeshua and Zerubbabel built the altar and offered burnt offerings morning and evening, though they feared the people of the land.
They celebrated the Feast of Weeks and offered daily burnt offerings, though the temple foundation was not yet laid.
They paid masons and carpenters and gave food, drink and oil to Sidon and Tyre for cedar logs shipped to Joppa.
In the second month of the second year, work began, and Levites twenty or older were appointed supervisors.
At the foundation, priests with trumpets and Levites with harps praised the LORD, and the people's noise was heard from afar.
